name: The diminutive (taṣghīr)
definition: Changing a noun to the pattern fuʿayl (and its longer forms) to make it small, dear or slight: nuṣayr from naṣr.
body: A three-letter noun becomes fuʿayl (rajul, rujayl), a four-letter one fuʿayʿil, a longer one fuʿayʿīl. The books set out how the weak letters return to their aṣl in the diminutive and which nouns cannot take it; al-Shāfiya and the Alfiyya have a chapter on it, and al-Amthila gives nuṣayr among the forms of naṣara.

examples.text: nuṣayr, the diminutive of naṣr, in al-Amthila.
